{{Top|leg}}
A '''M'Nes K'Lar''' ('''"Sanctuary of the True Faith'''") was a small building where adherents to the [[M'Nes]] religion on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] could meditate in peace and quiet. Every [[o'beki]] on Goroth Prime has a M'Nes K'Lar located within it.
